description:
Outcome: Coordinator receives one daily email listing new reports, from owner notification decision
Scope: Scheduled durable outbox/digest windows, coordinator-only recipient, reusable email adapter, configurable garden-local time, no empty email, minimal data/authenticated links, reports created since last successfully covered interval even if already resolved, stable idempotency keys, bounded retries and failure visibility. Excludes: instant notifications and marketing
Acceptance: All new reports included in appropriate digest; concurrent jobs produce one logical digest; retries/restarts do not omit reports; provider supports deduplication or ambiguous deliveries go to operator resolution rather than blind repeats
Behaviour: Delayed-job catch-up and visible failures; never mark sent before confirmed send
Verification: Fake-clock/provider tests and restart/concurrency/failure injection. Prerequisites: T-010, T-003. Assumptions: provider selected/configured before staging; daily hour configurable
title: Daily coordinator problem-report email
